messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: ci-packages-unavailable - Multiple CI jobs failing to fetch packages from GitHub Packages / api.pkg.github.com. Severity: P1 -> paging @Maya R. (oncall). Link: https://www.githubstatus.com/incident/abc123

Maya R.: on it. seeing a spike of failed install steps across prod-candidate and feature branches. logs show 502/504 from api.pkg.github.com when trying to pull private packages.

Build Bot: recent job: prod-hotfix-2026-03-15 #42 -> failed at 'install' step. npm/yarn errors: "unexpected response 502 from api.pkg.github.com". automatic retry attempted x2.

Jordan L.: tagging infra: are our mirrors up? can we proxy requests via artifactory?

Samir K.: infra team: artifactory is healthy but we don't mirror all private GH Packages. For this hotfix the package is only published to GH Packages.

Alex G.: customer Y needs hotfix deploy ASAP. CI blocked; builds can't produce artifacts. I have a locally built artifact but workflow enforces 'build via GH Actions' gate.

Maya R.: options: 1) temporarily update workflow to allow pulling artifact from internal S3; 2) create a tarball of node package (npm pack / pip wheel) and upload to S3, change install step to use that URL; 3) use last good container image from our registry and do a manual rollout; 4) wait for GitHub resolution (unknown ETA).

Priya S.: Product: prefer manual deploy for high-value customers with audit trail + rollback; we need customer-facing note.

Samir K.: Security note: any artifact source change needs hash verification and a brief signoff. We can implement URL+sha256 check in the workflow snippet. If doing manual deploy, ensure we record hashes and approvals in INC ticket.

Alex G.: I can create a signed tarball: `npm pack` -> `sha256sum` -> upload to s3://redwood-temp-artifacts/hotfix-20260315.tgz. Who can patch the workflow to use that URL?

Jordan L.: I can push a small patch to the pipeline that checks `ARTIFACT_URL` env var. But GH Actions UI is degraded so pushing might also have issues. We can run a short-lived script on CI runner host to perform deployment steps manually.

Build Bot: note: self-hosted runners are reachable but the step that contacts `api.pkg.github.com` times out. This implies GH Packages endpoint on the public side is affected.

Maya R.: plan agreed: emergency manual deployment path. Steps: (A) Alex pack & upload artifact to S3 and provide sha256; (B) Jordan will run deployment script on a healthy runner (bypassing package fetch), (C) Samir to run smoke tests & monitor metrics, (D) Priya publish status message. Approvals: Product + Security acknowledged in thread.

Alex G.: artifact uploaded. url: `https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-temp-artifacts/hotfix-20260315.tgz` sha256: `f1e2d3c4b5a6...` (full hash in incident ticket).

Jordan L.: executing deploy script on runner-07: `./deploy-hotfix.sh --artifact-url "$ARTIFACT_URL" --verify-sha $SHA256 --env prod-candidate`

Jordan L.: deploy script output: pulled artifact from S3, installed into a fresh container, built image, pushed image to staging-registry (staging.redwood.internal/hotfix:20260315). Push ok.

Samir K.: initiating rolling update to one pod for canary: `kubectl set image deploy/core-service core=staging.redwood.internal/hotfix:20260315 -n prod-candidate --record`

Maya R.: canary smoke checks running: health endpoint OK, integration smoke tests hitting dependent services pass. No error spikes. Keeping watch on error budget and latency graphs.

Priya S.: drafting status: "We are experiencing build and deployment interruptions due to a GitHub Packages/Actions outage affecting package pulls. For high-priority customers we've applied a manual deployment procedure; automated pipelines will be re-enabled after GitHub recovers and we validate artifact integrity." Posting to status.redwood.ai now.

incident-bot: NOTE: add post-incident reminders -> required: postmortem, CI fallback runbook, package mirroring plan.

Alex G.: promotion done to 100% after 20m, system metrics stable vs baseline. Rolling back if any sign of failure.

Samir K.: handoff: I'll remain shadowing another 30m then hand off to Maya for overnight. leaving detailed steps in INC-2026-105.

Maya R.: taking over at 05:00 UTC. followups for postmortem: 1) implement alternate artifact fetch path in workflows (ARTIFACT_URL flag + sha verification), 2) mirror frequently used private packages to artifactory or S3, 3) CI health monitor to detect external package provider failures faster.

Jordan L.: created ticket INFRA-459: package-mirroring + CI fallback. assigned to infra team.

Priya S.: customer comms live. Notifying affected customers via email for those with open support cases.

incident-bot: INCIDENT resolved: issue mitigated by manual artifact staging and controlled deploy. Severity reduced to P3 for follow-up work. :white_check_mark:
